turns.prompt_text: What can you gather about this website?: https://www.neapolitanlabs.com/
turns.response_html:
Based on the website and its portfolio, Neapolitan Labs is a full-service digital agency headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa, that specializes in web development, digital marketing, and proprietary software solutions.

From a holistic perspective—considering their technical work, their client base, and their company culture—here is what can be gathered about them:

1. Core Services & Technical Niche

Neapolitan Labs positions itself as a "boutique" firm that handles the entire lifecycle of a digital project through a three-stage process: Blueprint (strategy/wireframing), Build (development), and Boost (marketing/launch).

  • Proprietary CMS (Mint Chip Lab): Unlike many agencies that rely solely on WordPress or Squarespace, they developed their own content management system called Mint Chip Lab. It is specifically designed to be "user-friendly" for clients who aren't tech-savvy, allowing them to manage complex data like meeting minutes, election results, and emergency alerts.
  • Government & Education Specialty: They have carved out a significant niche in the public sector, specifically for county governments, school districts, and election offices. Their tools are built to handle the unique compliance needs (like ADA accessibility) and transparency requirements (like searchable archives of public documents) of these entities.

2. Market Reach & Experience

  • Regional Roots, National Growth: While they are deeply rooted in Iowa and the Midwest (having worked with over 20 Iowa counties and numerous local school districts), they have recently expanded their footprint to states like Alabama, Minnesota, Georgia, and Florida.
  • Longevity: The company was founded in 2004 (originally as McMillin Web Development) and rebranded to Neapolitan Labs in 2016. This 20+ year history suggests a high level of stability and long-term client retention.

3. Client Portfolio & Impact

Their work often focuses on "demystifying" complex information for the general public. Notable projects include:

  • Pottawattamie County: A comprehensive redesign that included an internal intranet for staff and a search-centric public site for residents.
  • Tourism Bureaus: They have won awards (like the "Outstanding Website" award at the Iowa Tourism Conference) for sites like UNleashCB.com (Council Bluffs CVB).
  • Elections: They provide specialized "Elections" toolsets for Auditor's Offices to display real-time polling information and results.

4. Company Culture & "Vibe"

  • Human-Centric Approach: The website emphasizes "meeting one-on-one" with departments and highlights the personal interests of their team (e.g., the founder's passion for photographing every town in Iowa).
  • The "Neapolitan" Theme: The name and branding are a nod to the founder's love of ice cream. This playful branding is integrated into their products (like the "Mint Chip Lab" CMS) and suggests a culture that values creativity and approachable professionalism.
  • Community Integration: They are active in professional associations (like the National Association of Counties) and frequently attend conferences to stay connected with the specific communities they serve.

In summary: If you are looking at them from a business perspective, they are a reliable, specialized firm for organizations that need more than just a "brochure" website—specifically those requiring custom data management and public-facing transparency tools. From a community perspective, they act as a bridge between local government and residents, focusing on making civic information accessible and mobile-friendly.
